Обрати внимание, что в режиме омметра му: Note that in ohmmeter mode the multimeter itself applies a small source and measures the resulting voltage or current. Notice the asymmetry when changing polarity.

Переключи мультиметр в режим измерения т: Switch the multimeter to current measurement mode and measure the current dependence on distance; use the concept of distributed resistance and that current spreads over the plate surface, so local areas near the electrodes often dominate.
Переключи омметр и измерь показания на в: Switch the ohmmeter and measure readings on all ranges for both polarities; consider that with identical plates the own EMF is small but may appear when current flows due to polarization.
Переключи прибор в режим измерения напря: Switch the device to voltage measurement mode and record the readings on the available ranges; here the device simply measures the voltage at its inputs (without an internal source).
Подключи мультиметр в амперметр и измерь: Connect the multimeter as an ammeter and measure the current at several distances between the cylinders.
Подключи пластины и последовательно изме: Connect the plates and sequentially measure all ohmmeter ranges at one polarity, then reverse the polarity.
Подключи прибор и дождись установления п: Connect the device and wait for the readings to stabilize on each range.
Подключи цилиндры и поочерёдно выбери вс: Connect the cylinders and sequentially select all ohmmeter ranges.

Сними показания омметра в нескольких диа: Record the ohmmeter readings in several ranges with the same connections and polarities.
